name: iosxe_translate
description: Translate Cisco IOS-XE CLI <-> NETCONF/XML. In the code sandbox this is exposed as the `iosxe` helper object: iosxe.models(filter) (list downloaded YANG modules, Tier B), iosxe.schema_tree(module, path, depth) (pyang tree of real containers/leaves, Tier B), iosxe.validate_native(native_xml) (namespace check, Tier B), iosxe.cli_to_rpc(cli_text) (Cisco-IOS-XE-cli-rpc envelope, Tier C transport only), iosxe.cli_to_native(device, cli_text, restconf_path) (WRITE: apply CLI on a device and read back native XML, Tier A device-verified), iosxe.native_to_cli(device, native_xml, restconf_path, method) (WRITE: apply native XML and diff show running-config, Tier A). Each method returns {ok, op, data, error, tier, blast_radius}. Tier A is authoritative (device-verified); Tier B is model-grounded but NOT device-verified; Tier C is transport, not native translation. Never invent paths/namespaces; ground them via schema_tree. cli_to_native/native_to_cli change live config (blast 'high').

function.name: iosxe_translate
function.description: Translate Cisco IOS-XE CLI <-> NETCONF/XML. Exposed as the `iosxe` helper object in the sandbox.

module.description: schema_tree only: YANG module name (e.g. Cisco-IOS-XE-native)

path.description: schema_tree only: data path to scope the tree (e.g. native/interface)

filter.description: models only: case-insensitive module-name substring filter

cli_text.description: cli_to_rpc / cli_to_native: IOS-XE configuration CLI (config-only; no show/exec)

native_xml.description: validate_native / native_to_cli: native YANG XML payload

device.description: cli_to_native / native_to_cli: pyATS device name to run against

restconf_path.description: cli_to_native / native_to_cli: RESTCONF data path (e.g. native/interface/Loopback=1)

method.description: native_to_cli only: RESTCONF write method (default PATCH)
